gates.title: Whole target design and independent review
gates.closure: The current feature scope, dependencies, ownership and acceptance IDs have independent review.
gates.review_reason: The 2026-10-14 fix wave changed schema, architecture, catalogs, acceptance cases, package scope, workflow and design handoff inputs. Prior fingerprints are historical provenance; review the corrected current inputs independently.

gates.title: Implementation kickoff
gates.closure: Separate explicit implementation authorization for the reviewed frozen version. Package state is recorded only in docs/build-progress.json.

authorization.words: I authorize implementation kickoff for EveryField v3.
authorization.question: Do you give explicit implementation-kickoff approval for EveryField v3 (spec 2026-10-13.current-1)?
authorization.channel: Intent chat, answer to the coordinator's kickoff question

gates.title: Concrete paid spending
gates.closure: Approve itemized tiers/usage/low-expected-high monthly envelope and recovery/operator costs before any subscription or usage commitment. No vendor/destination re-vote.

gates.title: Merged development workflow
gates.closure: W0 to W5 are merged, and one task has run end to end through the Phase 7 flow: isolated worktree and local preview, real verification by an independent verifier session (another Claude Code session, verifier seat, Opus model; D82), green GitHub CI on the exact head, a PR body meeting the standard, and merge through the new flow. Preserve feedback routing and owner approval rules.

source.end_to_end_evidence: This status takes effect when evf ship merges OPS-1: the merge requires green required CI on the exact head, an EVF-Review approval from the other model family after verify-preview, and a PR body meeting the standard. The OPS-1 PR and its review comment are the record.

gates.title: Authorized environment setup, with backup setup before customer data
gates.closure: Approved development and production environments are available. Customer-data recovery capability is required before customer data.

gates.title: Compatibility, concurrency and UI/model proof
gates.closure: Selected feature acceptance cases pass on the actual application, including access denials, concurrency, corrections and native/Evry parity.

gates.title: Before customer data
gates.closure: Before customer data, demonstrate recoverable private data and files, current deletion and access decisions, one-hour recovery point and four-hour recovery time, plus a daily fallback within 24 hours. Review privacy disclosure and operator access.

gates.title: Measured scheduler load and fairness
gates.closure: Representative background workloads complete without starving tenants or job kinds. Operators can see failures and recover interrupted work. This applies before production schedules.

gates.title: Early access site go-live
gates.closure: WP-097 only: normal tests, cross-model review, reviewed access/privacy/terms copy and Sebastian approval of the Vercel preview before production. No signed evf proof. Owner ruling 2026-10-14; product workflow and before-customer-data gates remain separate. Use Vercel everyfield, new Neon everyfield-v3 and Resend; never v2 database values.

gates.title: ADR-001 before-alpha stages 1 and 2
gates.owner: Pipeline, program, resident and integration owners
gates.closure: ADR-001 stages 1 and 2 pass their selected acceptance cases after S2 and before alpha. Stages 3 and 4, coaching and cross-church individual sharing remain deferred.

owner_product_questions.scope: outside alpha; individual organization Person removal follows REQ-MUL-005; no whole-organization deletion operation or policy is introduced.
owner_product_questions.title: Whole-organization deletion
owner_product_questions.recommendation: Keep whole-organization deletion outside alpha until Sebastian approves its separate policy; do not infer it from individual Person removal.
